name: Throne-Spear Adjudicator
loreTies: A martial officer of the Radiant Hierarchies who treats every cross-faction incursion as a case requiring forceful ruling.
Uses reach and zone denial to pin Titan movement.
source culture humans later copied as angelic and heavenly lore
shortBackstory: Throne-Spear Adjudicator is a lore-faithful Empyrean run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Throne-Spear Adjudicator belongs to The Radiant Hierarchies and exists to express Empyrean law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Uses reach and zone denial to pin Titan movement.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Tall ivory-gold armor, throne-wheel backpiece, long radiant spear, sapphire judgment core. Abilities — Adjudicator Thrust, Radiant Interdict, Edict Step — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Titan-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
